# Atmos™ Rewards Ascent card


**LIMITED TIME OFFER: 70,000 bonus points**


and a $99 Companion Fare after spending $2,500 or more on purchases within the first 90 days of opening your account.


**Annual Fee:** $95


3x


points for every $1 spent on eligible Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines purchases


2x


points for every $1 spent on eligible gas, EV charging station, cable, streaming services and local transit (including ride share) purchases


1x


point per $1 spent on all other purchases


10%


rewards bonus on all points earned from card purchases if you have an eligible Bank of America® account


[Learn more](https://www.bankofamerica.com/credit-cards/products/alaska-airlines-credit-card/?utm_source=roametravel)


### Why We Like This Card


The Atmos™ Rewards Ascent Visa Signature® Card is a practical mid-tier option for anyone who flies Alaska Airlines or Hawaiian Airlines even once or twice a year. With a $95 annual fee, the card easily pays for itself through core flight perks: you and up to six companions get a free checked bag ($70 round-trip value per person) and preferred boarding whenever you book flights with the card. Spending $6,000 on the card annually unlocks a $99 Companion Fare, making it simple to recoup the annual fee on a single trip. You also earn 3x points on Alaska and Hawaiian flight purchases, 2x points on everyday transit, gas, EV charging, cable, and streaming services, plus 1 status point for every $3 spent toward earning Atmos elite status. For Bank of America account holders, an automatic 10% rewards bonus pushes those earning rates even higher.


### Other Benefits


- Get a $99 Companion Fare (plus taxes and fees from $23) each account anniversary after you spend $6,000 or more on purchases within the prior anniversary year. Valid on all Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines flights within North America booked on AlaskaAir.com.


- Earn a 10% rewards bonus on all points earned from card purchases if you have an eligible Bank of America® account.


- Free checked bag and preferred boarding for you and up to 6 guests traveling on the same reservation when you purchase Alaska Airlines or Hawaiian Airlines airfare with your card.


- Earn and redeem across 1,000+ destinations worldwide with oneworld® Alliance member airlines and 30+ global air partners.


- No foreign transaction fees.
